roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and maintaining robust infection prevention protocols, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for residents and staff. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of continuous learning and health compliance. We are seeking a proactive and experienced Registered Nurse to lead our staff development initiatives and oversee our infection control program. This position offers an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on patient outcomes and staff competency within a supportive environment. We value your expertise and commitment to excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility
Demonstrated experience in staff education and development
Proven experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, compensation based on experience.

description: Are you an experienced Marketing Director looking for a pivotal role in a dynamic environment? A premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL, is seeking a highly motivated and results-driven individual to lead its marketing efforts. This is a unique opportunity to join a recently purchased facility, bringing your expertise to shape its future success and growth.We are looking for a strategic leader who can drive census growth and enhance community presence. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in developing and executing innovative marketing strategies, building strong relationships, and ensuring the facility's continued reputation for excellence. This role offers significant impact and the chance to be part of a transformative period for the organization.This position requires a professional who is prepared to work occasional weekends to meet business needs and engage with the community effectively. We offer a highly competitive compensation package for the right candidate, reflecting the importance of this role.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare setting.
Professional demeanor and appearance, representing the facility with excellence.
Strong drive and a results-oriented approach to achieving marketing and census goals.
Ability to work occasional weekends as required for community events or outreach.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is highly competitive and based on experience for the right candidate.

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP). This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, along with a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus. We are seeking a dedicated professional to provide essential speech and language therapy services to our patients.

As a PRN SLP, you will have the flexibility to manage your schedule while making a significant impact on patient recovery and quality of life. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking for a compassionate and skilled therapist to join our team immediately.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Current Florida state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity allows you to provide essential therapy services, contributing to patient recovery and well-being on a flexible schedule.

In this role, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing individualized treatment plans to help patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. This is an excellent chance to make a significant impact while enjoying the flexibility of a PRN position.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work collaboratively within a therapy team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation ranges from $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description: Are you a dedicated Physical Therapist, Occupational Therapist, Speech-Language Pathologist, Physical Therapist Assistant, or Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant seeking a rewarding opportunity in Ocala, FL? A premier skilled nursing facility is actively seeking talented rehabilitation professionals to join their dynamic team. This is an excellent chance to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being within a supportive environment.This facility offers competitive compensation for both full-time and part-time positions, providing flexibility to suit your lifestyle. You'll have the opportunity to work with a diverse patient population, utilizing your expertise to deliver high-quality, individualized therapy services.If you are passionate about rehabilitation and ready to contribute to a team dedicated to excellence, we encourage you to apply. Join a facility committed to fostering professional growth and providing exceptional patient care.
requirements: Current state licensure/certification as a Physical Therapist (PT), Occupational Therapist (OT), Speech-Language Pathologist (ST/SLP), Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA), or Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) in Florida.
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred.
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for COTA/PTA roles ranges from $28.00 - $37.00/hr. Compensation for PT/OT/ST roles ranges from $40.00 - $46.00/hr.
